rp-wl-02.back: Under 2 m at midsummer, under 10% emergent plants.

rp-wl-03.back: Flooded with nutrient rich water, over 10% cover of cattail, bulrush, sedges.

rp-wl-04.back: Wooded wetland: 25% or more cover of trees or tall shrubs.

rp-wl-05.back: Sphagnum moss peat fed by rain, acid; Labrador tea, bog cranberry, stunted spruce or pine.

rp-wl-06.back: Peat over 40 cm fed by groundwater; sedges, willow, scrub birch.
